info.title: Live Commerce catalog and inventory admin API
info.description: T04 merchant-only slice, not a complete SaaS/live-provider approval. Runtime requests derive Scope from a merchant session; client tenant headers and Host are not authority. No public reserve route.

get.description: Requires catalog:read. Stable keyset cursor, default 50/max100. No snapshot across requests.
